description: This file is a PHP class definition for the 'Marketing' model within the OpenCart admin extension. It provides methods to retrieve marketing-related data, including campaign statistics and totals, from the database.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class for handling marketing-related database queries in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Retrieves marketing campaign data, including clicks, orders, and total sales, with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalMarketing
methods.description: Returns the total number of marketing campaigns.
